case-cover.title: Case 8: the open cabinet

config.title: Case file: the workbench transmitter
config.story: You've been testing a transmitter on the bench with its cover off. Several stations report hearing you outside the band.
evidence: The reports come from frequencies outside the band you're using.
The cover and its shielding are sitting on the shelf.
config.caption: Your signal heard where it shouldn't be: a buzzy carrier well away from your frequency.

case-cover.success: Without its shielding the transmitter radiates spurious emissions. Put the cover back on.

case-clicks.title: Case 9: the clicking CW

config.title: Case file: the distant complaint
config.story: A station 500 km away says your CW clicks are wiping out signals several kHz either side of you.
evidence: The clicks happen at the start and end of every element.
Your frequency is steady: no chirp.
It started after you repaired the keying circuit.
config.caption: Sharp clicks at the start and end of every dit and dah, spreading well either side of the CW signal.

case-clicks.success: Too-sharp keying edges: key clicks. Check the keying filter and the stages after it.
